notes: needs_ruling: the story is Kurayb's, and the saying is Umm Salama's account of the Prophet's words; her own hearing is quoted inside Kurayb's narration, so whether she is a link after Kurayb is not settled by the text (rule 6, rule 11)
Ibn Abbas and the messengers («أرسلوه») are in the scene only; «قال ابن عباس وكنت أصرف» is a quoted remark inside the scene, not a route
«- وهو ابن الحارث -» is a gloss on عمرو, left out; «مولى ابن عباس» is a patronymic, left out
The Prophet is the end of the chain
